rows.text:
M4 — Activation and accountability

Future award-specific issues track accepted terms, benefit delivery and use, real reporting deadlines, renewal, restricted-fund controls, and exit. Awarded, Activated, and Reporting are separately evidenced. No current awards or invented due date.

No due date
0% complete
0 open
0 closed

M3 — Authorized pursuit

Future issues only after explicit scope-bound authorization for outreach or submission, confirmed applicant eligibility, and independent review. Tracks approved pursuit, never promises an award. No current application commitments or invented due date.

No due date
0% complete
0 open
0 closed

M2 — Support qualification

Accept provider-specific research, evidence, eligibility gates, use cases, restrictions, and defensible scoring. Completing research may conclude Ineligible or Not Pursuing and never means an application was submitted or funding obtained. No assumed due date.

No due date

M1 — Foundation evidence

Accept the administrative baseline, needs, budget assumptions, legal readiness analysis, governance drafts, and program controls. Completion means independently accepted research and preparation, not legal recognition or funds received. Outcome-based; no invented due date.
